transitions.name: Block Motion
transitions.desc: picture breaks into sliding blocks that fly in from one side

transitions.name: Flip Motion
transitions.desc: outgoing picture flips away like a card, the next one flips in

transitions.name: Fold Motion
transitions.desc: picture folds in half like paper and unfolds into the next

transitions.name: Pop Motion
transitions.desc: next picture pops in from small with a springy overshoot

transitions.name: Pull Motion
transitions.desc: outgoing picture is pulled away, shrinking toward the edge

transitions.name: Spin Motion
transitions.desc: both pictures spin around the centre with motion blur

transitions.name: Spring Motion
transitions.desc: next picture bounces in on a spring from one side

transitions.name: Travel Motion
transitions.desc: camera travels sideways from one picture to the next, both shrink a little

transitions.name: Additive Dissolve
transitions.desc: bright dissolve: the two pictures add up, highlights flare

transitions.name: Blur Dissolve
transitions.desc: dissolve through a heavy blur, soft and dreamy

transitions.name: Burn Alpha
transitions.desc: outgoing picture burns away with glowing fiery edges

transitions.name: Cross Dissolve
transitions.desc: classic soft cross-fade

transitions.name: Dip to Black
transitions.desc: fade to black, then up into the next picture

transitions.name: Dip to Color
transitions.desc: fade through a solid colour (default red)

transitions.name: Dip to White
transitions.desc: fade through white, like an overexposed flash

transitions.name: Film Dissolve
transitions.desc: film-like dissolve with a slightly darker, gamma-correct mix

transitions.name: Luma Fade
transitions.desc: dissolve where the bright areas change first, then the darks

transitions.name: Morph Cut
transitions.excluded: meant for talking-head jump cuts; on unrelated pictures it is just a muddy dissolve

transitions.name: Mosaic
transitions.desc: pictures dissolve through big pixel blocks

transitions.name: Chaos
transitions.desc: broken digital blocks tear the picture apart, harsh glitch

transitions.name: Earthquake
transitions.desc: violent shake with motion blur across the cut

transitions.name: Flicker
transitions.desc: rapid flickering between the two pictures like a bad bulb

transitions.name: Glass
transitions.desc: picture shatters into glass cells that refract the next one

transitions.name: Glitch
transitions.desc: digital glitch: coloured blocks and RGB noise over the cut

transitions.name: Grunge
transitions.desc: dirty burnt-paper holes eat the picture away

transitions.name: Kaleidoscope
transitions.desc: pictures turn into a spinning kaleidoscope mandala

transitions.name: Liquid Distortion
transitions.desc: picture melts and wobbles like liquid into the next

transitions.name: TV Power
transitions.desc: old TV switching off to a white line and back on

transitions.name: VHS Damage
transitions.desc: VHS tape damage: noise, colour bleed and tracking lines

transitions.name: VR Light Rays
transitions.desc: blinding starburst of light rays from the centre

transitions.name: VR Mobius Zoom
transitions.desc: psychedelic spiral zoom that twists both pictures

transitions.name: VR Random Blocks
transitions.desc: random square blocks switch to the next picture

transitions.name: Burn Chroma
transitions.desc: hot colour burn: the cut flares through saturated colour

transitions.name: Chroma Leak
transitions.desc: rainbow chroma leak washes over the cut

transitions.name: Cross Zoom
transitions.desc: fast zoom-blur punch into the next picture

transitions.name: Directional Blur
transitions.desc: sideways motion-blur smear between pictures

transitions.name: Flare
transitions.desc: warm anamorphic lens flare sweeps across the cut

transitions.name: Flash
transitions.desc: bright white camera flash at the cut

transitions.name: Glow
transitions.desc: everything blooms into glow, then settles on the next picture

transitions.name: Lens Blur
transitions.desc: defocus out, refocus in (camera lens blur)

transitions.name: Light Leak
transitions.desc: warm orange film light leak over the cut

transitions.name: Light Sweep
transitions.desc: a bright diagonal light bar sweeps across

transitions.name: Phosphor
transitions.desc: old CRT phosphor afterglow: outgoing picture lingers as a glow

transitions.name: Radial Blur
transitions.desc: spin blur around the centre into the next picture

transitions.name: Ray
transitions.desc: light rays streak out of the bright parts

transitions.name: Solarize
transitions.desc: colours invert and posterize for a moment, psychedelic

transitions.name: Stripe
transitions.desc: diagonal black-and-white stripes wipe across

transitions.name: Zoom Blur
transitions.desc: radial zoom blur out of one picture into the next

transitions.name: 3D Roll
transitions.desc: 3D cube-like roll from one picture to the next

transitions.name: Film Roll
transitions.desc: film strip rolls by with sprocket holes between frames

transitions.name: Push
transitions.desc: next picture pushes the old one out of frame

transitions.name: Roll
transitions.desc: pictures roll past with a slight 3D bend

transitions.name: Slide
transitions.desc: next picture slides in over the old one

transitions.name: Split
transitions.desc: old picture splits in two halves that slide apart

transitions.name: Stretch
transitions.desc: next picture stretches in from one edge

transitions.name: Whip
transitions.desc: fast whip-pan with heavy motion blur

transitions.name: Motion Camera
transitions.desc: virtual camera zooms and rotates between the two pictures

transitions.name: Motion Tween
transitions.desc: gentle scale tween that blends the pictures

transitions.name: Shape Dissolve
transitions.desc: dissolve through many small shapes (circles, stars, hearts...)

transitions.name: Shape Flow
transitions.desc: one big shape (circle, star, heart...) grows to reveal the next picture

transitions.name: Text Animator
transitions.excluded: text-clip transition (works on text graphics, not pictures)

transitions.name: Typewriter
transitions.excluded: text-clip transition (works on text graphics, not pictures)

transitions.name: 3D Spin
transitions.desc: picture spins in 3D around its axis, revealing the next on the back

transitions.name: 3D Spinback
transitions.desc: picture swings back into depth and the next swings forward

transitions.name: Frame
transitions.desc: pictures shrink into a white-bordered frame and swap

transitions.name: Louver
transitions.desc: horizontal blinds (louvers) flip open to the next picture

transitions.name: Mirror
transitions.desc: mirrored split that folds into the next picture

transitions.name: Page Peel
transitions.desc: the corner peels like paper to reveal the next picture

transitions.name: Slice
transitions.desc: diagonal slices slide in different directions

transitions.name: Wave
transitions.desc: a wave ripples through and carries the next picture in

transitions.name: Clock Wipe
transitions.desc: clock-hand sweep reveals the next picture

transitions.name: Linear Wipe
transitions.desc: straight wipe line moves across

transitions.name: Neon Wipe
transitions.desc: glowing neon line wipes across

transitions.name: Panel Wipe
transitions.desc: staggered panels wipe in like a blocky curtain

transitions.name: Plateau Wipe
transitions.desc: stepped plateau-shaped wipe

transitions.name: Radial Wipe
transitions.desc: radial wipe sweeping from a corner

transitions.name: Soft Wipe
transitions.desc: very soft gradient wipe, almost a directional dissolve

transitions.name: Star Wipe
transitions.desc: growing star shape reveals the next picture (cheesy on purpose)

transitions.name: Stretch Wipe
transitions.desc: picture stretches and smears out of frame

transitions.name: Barn Doors
transitions.desc: barn doors open from the middle

transitions.name: Center Split
transitions.desc: picture splits into four quarters that slide to the corners

transitions.name: Inset
transitions.desc: next picture grows from a corner as a rectangle

transitions.name: Iris Box
transitions.desc: rectangle iris opens from the centre

transitions.name: Iris Cross
transitions.desc: cross-shaped iris opens from the centre

transitions.name: Iris Diamond
transitions.desc: diamond iris opens from the centre

transitions.name: Iris Round
transitions.desc: round iris opens from the centre (old cinema)

transitions.name: Non-Additive Dissolve
transitions.desc: dissolve where the brighter picture wins pixel by pixel, contrasty

transitions.name: Wipe
transitions.desc: plain hard-edged wipe

transitions.name: Band Slide
transitions.desc: horizontal bands slide in from alternating sides

transitions.name: Checker Wipe
transitions.desc: checkerboard of small cells wipes across

transitions.name: Cube Spin
transitions.desc: 3D cube rotation from one face to the next

transitions.name: Flip Over
transitions.desc: picture flips over in 3D, black behind

transitions.name: Gradient Wipe
transitions.desc: soft diagonal gradient wipe

transitions.name: Page Turn
transitions.desc: page turns from the corner like a book

transitions.name: Venetian Blinds
transitions.desc: venetian blinds close and reopen on the next picture

effects.name: Tint
effects.desc: duotone: darks and lights mapped to two colours

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.desc: soft blur over the whole picture; animate it from high to 0 for a focus pull

effects.name: Directional Blur
effects.desc: motion-blur smear in one direction (speed feeling)

effects.name: Sharpen
effects.desc: crisper edges and texture

effects.name: Camera Blur
effects.desc: out-of-focus camera lens blur

effects.name: Black & White
effects.desc: plain black-and-white

effects.name: Color Pass
effects.desc: keeps one colour, everything else goes grey (Sin City look)

effects.name: Invert
effects.desc: photo negative

effects.name: Posterize
effects.desc: flat poster colours, fewer tones

effects.name: Mosaic
effects.desc: pixelate into big square blocks (8-bit / censorship)

effects.name: Find Edges
effects.desc: line-art sketch: only the edges stay

effects.name: Strobe Light
effects.desc: stroboscope: the picture flashes a colour at a fixed period

effects.name: Noise
effects.desc: film grain / video noise

effects.name: Crop
effects.desc: cinematic letterbox: black bars top/bottom (or sides)

effects.name: Horizontal Flip
effects.desc: mirror the picture left-right

effects.name: Vertical Flip
effects.desc: upside-down picture

effects.name: Edge Feather
effects.desc: soft dark fade around the frame edges

effects.name: Transform
effects.desc: skew / rotate the picture (slanted, off-kilter)

effects.name: Mirror
effects.desc: mirror the picture along a line through the centre (symmetry)

effects.name: Lens Distortion
effects.desc: fisheye bulge (negative) or pinch (positive) lens

effects.name: Twirl
effects.desc: swirl around the centre

effects.name: Wave Warp
effects.desc: wavy water-like distortion that moves

effects.name: 4-Color Gradient
effects.desc: colourful four-corner gradient washed over the picture

effects.name: Lens Flare
effects.desc: bright lens flare at a point (sun, lamp, magic)

effects.name: Lighting Effects
effects.excluded: too many parameters for one line

effects.name: Bokeh Blur
effects.desc: dreamy defocus with round bokeh highlights

effects.name: Focus Blur
effects.desc: tilt-shift miniature: sharp band in the middle, blurred top and bottom

effects.name: Vignette
effects.desc: darkened corners that pull the eye to the centre (positive amount = white vignette)

effects.name: Magnify
effects.desc: magnifying glass circle over a spot

effects.name: Spherize
effects.desc: spherical bulge of the centre

effects.name: Turbulent Displace
effects.desc: heat-haze wobble / dream distortion

effects.name: Rounded Crop
effects.desc: picture inset as a rounded card with a border

effects.name: Echo Glow
effects.desc: layered bloom echoes around bright areas

effects.name: Edge Glow
effects.desc: neon outline glowing along edges

effects.name: Glint
effects.desc: star sparkles on the brightest highlights

effects.name: Light Leaks
effects.desc: drifting warm film light leaks

effects.name: RGB Split
effects.desc: chromatic aberration: red/blue channels shifted apart

effects.name: Volumetric Rays
effects.desc: god rays streaming from the bright parts

effects.name: Wonder Glow
effects.desc: soft bloom glow around highlights

effects.name: Brush Strokes
effects.desc: painterly brush strokes, like an oil painting

effects.name: Color Emboss
effects.desc: embossed relief with colours kept, like a metal stamp

effects.name: Posterize Time
effects.desc: choppy stop-motion: fewer frames per second

effects.name: 3D Rotate
effects.desc: picture tilted in 3D space like a card

effects.name: Camera Shake
effects.desc: handheld camera shake

effects.name: Spin
effects.desc: picture spins once over the shot (zoomed so no edges show)

effects.name: Wiggle
effects.desc: random jittery wiggle of position

effects.name: Clone
effects.desc: grid of copies of the picture (pop-art)

effects.name: Echo
effects.desc: motion trails: earlier frames ghost behind moving things

effects.name: Lightning
effects.desc: electric lightning bolt across the frame

effects.name: Block Dissolve
effects.desc: picture breaks into missing blocks (animate 0 to 100 to dissolve it away)

effects.name: VR Digital Glitch
effects.desc: animated digital glitch: block displacement, colour channels, scanlines
